questions.stem: A 7 year old child has been complaining of right continuous offensive ear discharge for the last 3 years. A month ago he began to suffer from headache, fever and some vomiting for which he received symptomatic treatment. The patient’s condition was stable for a while, then after 2 weeks he started to suffer from severe headache and drowsiness. The patient also noticed difficulty going up and down the stairs. A week later, he developed weakness in the left arm and left leg, and became markedly drowsy. He became comatose the next day.Choose the most inappropriate statement in context of diagnosis:

options.label: A
options.text: Difficulty in going up and down the stairs is due to hemiparesis

options.label: B
options.text: Canal wall down mastioidectomy is the required remove the cholesteatoma from the ear

options.label: C
options.text: Lumbar puncture should be done to diagnose underlying cause.

options.label: D
options.text: Antibiotics that cross the blood brain barrier should be next step.
